description: A React component implementing an AI assistant panel with features like prompt input, AI actions (summarize, quiz, explain), history management, and sharing/saving results. It includes accessibility features, event handling, and integration with external services.

methods.name: afterRunStore
methods.description: Stores the result of an AI action in history and updates selected ID.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an AI action (summarize, quiz, explain) and manages loading/error states.

methods.name: openFromHistory
methods.description: Loads a previous AI result from history into the panel.

methods.name: copyCurrent
methods.description: Copies the current AI result to clipboard.

methods.name: saveToNotes
methods.description: Saves the current AI result to notes repository.

methods.name: shareCurrent
methods.description: Creates a share link for the current AI result and copies it to clipboard.

methods.name: clearContextHistory
methods.description: Clears the AI history for the current context.
